rules.semantic: A broken door is replaced by an opening-door effect on its spot (same floor, level, team); with a wall directly above the door the effect faces right (a vertical door), otherwise — verbatim classic quirk — FACE_UP is written onto the dead DOOR and the effect keeps its spawn facing (down).

arms.observable: door_open curdir == FACE_RIGHT; door curdir unchanged
door curdir == FACE_UP; door_open curdir == FACE_DOWN (spawn default)

other.note: add_weap_ob('fx', core:door_open) failure guard: no opening effect, hook reports unhandled.
